responsibility: Implements tree/GIMPLE exception-handling bookkeeping and cleanup. It records and queries the mapping from potentially-throwing statements to EH landing pads or must-not-throw regions, manages EH-region and finally/goto relationships during lowering and duplication, verifies EH edges, and provides the ehcleanup pass that removes unreachable or empty handlers, unsplits and prunes EH structure, updates CFG/SSA as needed, and drops unnecessary personality routines after middle-end transformations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-level EH machinery declared in gcc/tree-eh.h. Unlike the header’s API surface, this file contains the actual landing-pad/region bookkeeping, EH-edge verification helpers, statement-to-region updates during transformations, and the ehcleanup GIMPLE pass.
